messages:
Sam (Support): :rotating_light: heads-up @Maya — OpalCare trial is blocked on onboarding, reporting repeated embed ingestion 502s. Customer wants a fix/ETA before renewal check in next month. TL;DR below.
Maya (CSM): on it. can you drop the logs and a quick timeline? also +1 to scheduling an enablement call.
Sam (Support): logs: ```
2024-04-15T13:02:47Z ERROR ingestion: embed endpoint 502 
req_id=7f4c3a, model=redwood-embed-v2, user_id=opal-742
stack: http timeout -> upstream 502
```
Sam (Support): last successful ingest was 2024-04-10. volume spike on 4/15 — support increased retries but still failing. customer tried re-ingest from UI.
Priya (Enablement): can we do a guided re-run with the customer and share checklist? I can host a 30m session tomorrow.
Dan (SRE): I started a quick check — upstream service shows elevated 5xxs between 13:00-13:10 UTC. I'm running a tail on the model proxy now, attaching findings shortly.
Maya (CSM): proposed comms: 1) immediate acknowledgement to OpalCare with ETA window, 2) enablement session + guided reingest, 3) follow-up async notes + preventive steps. Owner: Maya.
Sam (Support): copied from support side: we will keep request pinned, add session notes, and collect repro steps.
EngOps Bot: Incident created INC-20240415-OPAL (assigned to Dan).
Maya (CSM): priority handling: classify as "onboarding-blocker" and flag renewal risk. Ask: who can be on the quick triage call at 09:30 PT tomorrow?
Dan (SRE): I can join 09:30 PT. I'll bring request traces and a mitigation path (fallback to smaller batch sizes).
Priya (Enablement): I'll run the 30m session right after triage at 10:00 PT and walk them through the reingest checklist.
Sam (Support): I will prepare a short repro script and temporary support link.
Maya (CSM): messaging to customer (draft): "Thanks for flagging — we see the ingest failures and have opened a high-priority incident. We'll run a focused triage and a guided reingest session tomorrow; ETA for resolution window 24-72 hours depending on root cause. We'll keep you updated via this thread and schedule." ok to send? :white_check_mark:
Priya (Enablement): send it. also ask them to pause parallel bulk jobs until we clear this.
Dan (SRE): quick mitigation suggestion: add a retry-backoff and reduce concurrent batch size for user opal-742 — will test on staging now.
Maya (CSM): assigning tasks: Maya -> external comms & renewal note; Priya -> enablement session & checklist; Sam -> repro script & support pin; Dan -> triage & mitigation.
Sam (Support): noted. I'll update the incident with repro and attach customer logs.
EngOps Bot: INC-20240415-OPAL updated: status=triage, priority=high.
Maya (CSM): thanks team. I'll ping legal if we need contract concessions, but let's aim to fix first. Follow-ups here after triage.
Dan (SRE): initial staging test succeeded with smaller batches (no 502s). I'll push a temporary config change to production after 5m sanity checks.
Sam (Support): great, I'll coordinate the change window with the customer and book joint session.
Maya (CSM): closing loop: schedule invite to OpalCare + internal 15m postmortem slot after resolution.
Priya (Enablement): adding session checklist to shared drive and will post link here after upload.
Maya (CSM): :thumbsup: all set for tomorrow.
